AWPTCM-T43853.objective:
• A DHCP server configured with a 120-day lease time in a pool (via "lease 120 0 0") offers leases with exactly 120 days to clients.
  • DHCP clients obtain and use the 120-day lease time from the server, as verified in client lease info or server bindings.
  • The lease configuration appears correctly in running config and affects client lease duration.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.
Configure DUT as DHCP Server. Create a DHCP Pool with 120 day lease time (lease 120 0 0). Verify DHCP Server configuration in running config via "show run".

Connect a DHCP Client to obtain DHCP settings. Verify that the DHCP Client obtained the correct IP address and has a 120 day lease time (via "sh dhcp lease" on client or "sh ip dhcp binding" on server).
Verify lease operations are logged appropriately (e.g., new lease added, deleted).
